messages:
sara-sales: Heads up — FinTrust POC is asking for BYOK + HSM for encryption of customer data. They sent back the SIG and highlighted the KMS/HSM section with a hard blocker on our default KMS.
jon-se: Do they require an HSM backed key material (FIPS/HSM) for the POC or just an acceptance that keys are customer-managed? Any specific certs requested?
marta: I skimmed the questionnaire. They want BYOK with HSM-backed keys (FIPS 140-2 level 3) and proof of key custody. They flagged CAIQ s7.6 and s10.2. For a POC we could propose compensating controls instead of full on-prem HSM immediately.
kevin-legal: We should avoid blanket exceptions. Legal needs an addendum: limited-duration waiver for POC, scope-limited, with explicit acceptance of residual risk and insurance language. Also require attestation + audit access for the key usage logs.
security-bot: Automated review: "SIG_CAIG: KMS controls missing attestation. Risk: HIGH for BYOK without HSM. Recommend: ephemeral keys, audit, restricted roles." See report: https://redwood.internal/reports/1801234567
marta: Proposed compensating controls for a 60–90 day POC: 1) Customer-managed KMS keys hosted in their cloud account / customer uploads key material to our dedicated key account via AWS KMS import or KMIP gateway. 2) HSM-backed key option via partner (YubiHSM/CloudHSM) for high-sensitivity customers. 3) Immutable audit trail (CloudTrail -> dedicated S3 with object lock + cross-account access to customer's audit account). 4) Limited data scope and retention for POC, tokenization of PHI where possible. 5) Monthly review and immediate rollback plan.
jon-se: Can engineering enable the cross-account logging and key usage alerting quickly? Also need a short checklist we can send to FinTrust to sign off on.
marta: Yes, we can stand up cross-account CloudTrail and a lambda that notifies on Admin or GenerateDataKey events for the POC keys. Sample S3 policy to lock logs:
```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowCloudTrailPut",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"Service":"cloudtrail.amazonaws.com"},
      "Action":"s3:PutObject",
      "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-poc-logs/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
marta: We'll also require: key rotation schedule, MFA for key admins, and no export of plaintext keys to our infra. All key material must stay in customer's HSM/KMS.
sara-sales: FinTrust is okay with a short-term pragmatic approach if we put those controls in writing. They prefer 90 days so they can validate performance.
kevin-legal: Draft addendum: "Limited BYOK/HSM Waiver for POC — 90 days; compensating controls implemented as listed; customer audit rights; liability cap linked to POC scope." I'll prepare a one-pager.
jon-se: Action items:
- sara-sales: get FinTrust to sign the POC addendum and confirm which KMS/HSM vendor they'll use.
- marta: implement cross-account logging + alerts, document checklist for SEs.
- kevin-legal: draft waiver + addendum and share for security approval.
- jon-se: update vendor-risk tracker with waiver and target review date.

sara-sales: I'll ping FinTrust this afternoon and attach the checklist. thx all :thumbsup:
marta: If anyone's blocked, add to the tracker; once engineering publishes the checklist we can mark as approved for POC pending sign-off. We'll scope the exception to only the FinTrust POC and auto-expire at 90 days unless renewed.
kevin-legal: Noted. I'll post the draft here when ready for review. :memo:
jon-se: Thanks — looks reasonable. Once we have signatures, I'll move to "approved-with-controls" in the tracker. :white_check_mark:
